posts.title: Interactive Jensen–Shannon Divergence Visualisation
posts.description: An interactive visualisation of Jensen–Shannon divergence - the symmetric, always-finite cousin of KL. Shape two distributions and watch JSD, its ceiling of one bit, and the per-point contribution respond in real time.

posts.title: Interactive KL Divergence Visualisation
posts.description: An interactive visualisation of Kullback–Leibler divergence. Shape two distributions and watch forward vs reverse KL, the pointwise integrand, and the effects of asymmetry, support mismatch and discretisation.
